headline: Illinois becomes the 21st state
post_facts: That put Chicago's future site in Illinois

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen eighteen... Illinois became the twenty-first state.

scenes.label: Illinois, 1818
scenes.caption: Map of the new state
scenes.title: Almost without Chicago
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] But it almost joined the Union without Chicago.

scenes.label: the northern border moved north
scenes.text: [calmly] Delegate Nathaniel Pope got Congress to move its northern border about fifty-one miles.

scenes.label: Chicago, 1831
scenes.caption: Fort Dearborn by the lake
scenes.title: A shore on Lake Michigan
scenes.text: [softly] That gave Illinois Lake Michigan shoreline... and the future site of Chicago.

scenes.title: Springfield became capital in 1837
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Nineteen years later, the capital moved to Springfield.

scenes.title: Did you know Chicago almost missed Illinois?
scenes.text: [gently] Did you know Chicago almost wasn't in Illinois?
